## Why This Is Asked
Tests translating reliability goals into measurable SLIs/SLOs and a phased rollout that preserves velocity.

## Key Concepts
- SLOs and budgets
- Canary releases and phased rollouts
- Telemetry (OpenTelemetry) and tracing
- Backpressure and caching strategies
- Cross-functional alignment with product management

## Code Example
```javascript
function p95(data){
  data.sort((a,b)=>a-b);
  return data[Math.floor(0.95*data.length)];
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you handle conflicting SLIs across services?
- How would you convince product teams if their feature requires latency increase?
